Title: The School Bus

Who's who

1. तरुण - 42, father
Look: light beard, office shirt, untidy hair
2. प्रिया - 40, mother
Look: cotton kurta, hair in a bun
3. वृंदा - 10, elder daughter
Look: round glasses, school uniform, two plaits
4. वनुशा - 4, younger daughter
Look: pink frock, sleepy eyes

Locations

1. the bedroom - a big bed, an alarm clock, a window
2. the gate - the society gate, a busy road, a yellow school bus

Props

1. alarm clock - a round red alarm clock
2. scooter - a blue scooter
3. lunch box - a green steel lunch box

The story begins

Scene 1 - the bedroom - Early morning

[वृंदा and वनुशा are fast asleep on the big bed. The alarm clock rings loudly.]

[प्रिया walks in, opens the curtains and the morning light falls on the bed.]

प्रिया (loudly): "Wake up, girls! The bus comes in ten minutes!"

वनुशा (sleepily): "Five more minutes, Mama..."

[वृंदा jumps out of bed, combs her hair in a hurry and brushes her teeth.]

Scene 2 - the bedroom - Morning

[तरुण runs in with one shoe on and a toothbrush in his mouth.]

तरुण (panicking): "Where are my keys? Has anyone seen my keys?"

वृंदा: "In your hand, Papa."

[तरुण looks at his hand, scratches his head and laughs.]

Scene 3 - the gate - Morning

[The wind slams the gate shut behind them. वृंदा runs after the yellow school bus with her lunch box.]

वृंदा (shouting): "Stop! Please stop!"

[The bus stops. वृंदा climbs in and waves through the window.]

[तरुण starts the scooter. वनुशा sits in front of him and प्रिया waves goodbye from the gate.]

प्रिया (smiling): "Every single morning,
the same circus."
